comments.mergedPostDetails: cant switch between hiding as user or known/trusted. button is missing.

comments.value:
Personally I never used the button /find it kinda dumb.
I understand the devs wanting to hide staff rank.
But kinda feels pointless to hide a users rank
@{5fb74d723473b36c24d385eb|full_name}: Plus tools like VRCX would just display the actual rank anyways. Not trying to shit on the feature.
@{5af8fc26a97e4b511e461b1d|full_name}: sometimes new users would avoid trusted users. I know I did that in my early days

@{603e82fafe778f69f8f27616|full_name}: Mostly for the entitled ones who go around flexing their roles are probably always going to exist no matter what. I kept myself on trusted and haven't had any issues and if someone doesn't know how to do something, for example gestures on desktop/vr, and asks, I just tell them how to do it no problem.

Surprised that this mindset is still a thing with the new nameplate. I thought the issue was due mainly to how obvious ranks were. Thus, with the new nameplates just making it seem more like an add-on status than an all encompassing colored rank, they no longer needed a way to hide it.
We can already tell even if you hide anyway. So it seems like wasted effort on the dev side for adding it and the user side for trying to hide it.

While I agree with this comment, I also think a toggle isn't hurting people who don't use it.  It might bring peace of mind to someone who uses it, if it prevents a visitor/new user from griefing them.
If the button isn't obnixious I don't see a problem with it.
never personally cared about it. i only used it when board pretending to be new

details: please give it back I dont want people to know im trusted
